capabilities.name: ads
capabilities.description: Audit, plan, create, or optimize paid campaigns across Google, Meta, YouTube, LinkedIn, TikTok, Microsoft, or Apple. Use for PPC, ROAS, CPA, targeting, bidding, retargeting, budgets, creative, or ad-spend questions.

capabilities.name: alchemist
capabilities.description: Execute a settled, bounded change through Legion's Alchemist authority. Use /alchemist after scope, ownership, checks, and acceptance are decided.

capabilities.name: architect
capabilities.description: Software and system architecture capability for architecture decisions, ADRs, quality attributes, interfaces, invariants, migrations, and architecture-significant planning.

capabilities.name: audit
capabilities.description: Diagnose a whole repository through Legion's frozen Audit provider plan. Use for /audit or repository-wide read-only health, security, runtime, & evidence review.

capabilities.name: audit-fix
capabilities.description: Apply bounded remediation from a frozen Legion Audit report, then rerun its same provider plan. Use only for /audit-fix after /audit evidence exists.

capabilities.name: audit-visual
capabilities.description: Review rendered UI through Legion's shared Audit visual provider. Use for /audit-visual, visual regressions, screenshot baselines, or rendered-state coverage.

capabilities.name: brand
capabilities.description: Load a source-bound brand card before branded content, design, marketing, social, or media work. Use /brand when a named brand or approved identity source governs an output.

capabilities.name: brand-identity
capabilities.description: Create, audit, evolve, or apply brand identities, systems, guidelines, visual identity, voice, naming, logo direction, brand books, rebrands, website or app identity, pitch decks, or social kits.

capabilities.name: coder
capabilities.description: Explicit opt-in router for scoped read-only code analysis through external API models. Use only for `/coder`, explicit outsourced API analysis, or a named API provider/model.

capabilities.name: commit
capabilities.description: Review, verify, commit, & push one frozen diff through Legion's guarded Commit workflow. Use for /commit, review and commit, or commit and push.

capabilities.name: cortex
capabilities.description: Build a current, source-grounded repository map with Cortex. Use /cortex or /blueprint before inheriting, changing, auditing, or judging unfamiliar code.

capabilities.name: covenant
capabilities.description: Convene Legion's independent challenge chamber for a Sage decision, an Alchemist blocker, or packet-only review preparation. Use /covenant.

capabilities.name: debugger
capabilities.description: Diagnosis capability for reproducing failures, isolating evidence, forming disconfirmable hypotheses, establishing root cause, and selecting routine repairs. Do not use for preflight or completion-only verification.

capabilities.name: designer
capabilities.description: Create, redesign, or polish websites, app UI, dashboards, components, static creative, print, motion systems, glass materials, illustration direction, and frontend craft. Route review-only work to Audit Visual and identity systems to Brand Identity.

capabilities.name: dispatch
capabilities.description: Create a validated zero-context work packet for another agent or executor while current orchestrator retains responsibility. Use for delegation, parallel workers, or copy-paste executor instructions. Same-agent work stays inline; session continuity uses handoff.

capabilities.name: handoff
capabilities.description: Transfer an ongoing task into a fresh chat through a hash-bound transcript pointer and a validated cold-start continuation packet. Use for fresh-thread continuity, context rollover, or transfer of decisions, state, failures, and landmines; never use for bounded executor delegation.

capabilities.name: marketing
capabilities.description: Route positioning, offers, packaging, guarantees, launches, validation, growth, analytics, pricing, CRO, retention, and commercial ideation. Use for Grand Slam Offers or what, whom, why, and how to market; route execution to Ads, SEO, Social, Research, or Writing.

capabilities.name: qa
capabilities.description: Add, run, or audit local web or Tauri app QA: hidden servers, deterministic mocks, functional assertions, viewport captures, visual evidence, & contract-test authoring.

capabilities.name: research
capabilities.description: Sole top-level evidence router: general, market, technical, scientific, medical, legal, competitor, Reddit, audience, trends, scholarly, documents, authority, and NotebookLM. Medical and legal are private internal routes; India consumer-commission filing is a Legal workflow.

capabilities.name: seo
capabilities.description: Audit or improve SEO, GEO or AEO, AI citations, crawlability, indexing, Core Web Vitals, schema, sitemaps, content quality, E-E-A-T, images, hreflang, llms.txt, traffic drops, page speed, or repository SEO.

capabilities.name: social
capabilities.description: Route Instagram, Pinterest, YouTube, Twitter or X, LinkedIn, Reels, Shorts, pins, threads, calendars, distribution, analytics, and social growth. Use /social or when social strategy or content is the deliverable.

capabilities.name: tasklist
capabilities.description: Create an executable same-agent task list. Use `/tasklist`; keep it inline unless persistence, audit receipts, or a reusable record is requested. Use Dispatch for another agent & Handoff for a new chat.

capabilities.name: writing
capabilities.description: Route editorial prose, essays, newsletters, scripts, captions, threads, research articles, blogs, SEO posts, conversion copy, bios, DMs, product copy, email, and changelogs. Use when words are the deliverable.

roles.description: Controlled transformation authority. Dispatch to apply an already-bounded contract, integrate exact artifacts, run declared checks, & mechanically repair implementation failures. Do not dispatch for undecided meaning or independent assurance.
Independent assurance authority. Dispatch before every successful final delivery for read-only semantic Completion Validation. Do not dispatch to decide architecture or perform product-state effects.

Exceptional adjudication authority. Dispatch when a material unresolved decision cannot safely close under the selected capability's routine mandate. Do not dispatch for routine architecture, diagnosis, execution, or independent assurance.

hostCapabilities.degradation: Report that no agent host configuration was found and take no action; never create one speculatively.
Report unavailability to the caller and stop. This package ships no fallback generator.
Return a NO_CAPABILITY result naming cortex-graph. Never fall back to ad-hoc grep and never present ungraphed results as graph results.
Read the source files directly without compression.
Report that backlink/SERP data is unavailable and mark those findings UNPROVEN; never estimate them.
Fall back to raw HTTP fetch and state that no rendered DOM was available.
Research skips the local-corpus provider and records it as unrun.
Skip the media step and state that it was skipped.
Proceed without prior-run context and state that the run is cold.
Return results inline and state that they were not durably captured.
Research skips the notebooklm provider and records it as unrun.
Emit the uncompressed human deliverable only and state that no OKF bundle was produced.
Alchemist exits 4 (gateway down). Callers must treat Alchemist as unavailable, not as returning an empty result.
Research returns UNPROVEN for scholarly claims.
Write artifacts to the working directory and state that they were not emitted to the host.
Research returns UNPROVEN for any claim that required live retrieval.
